answer: Shards are assigned from the basalt graph, so that cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The juniper assignment is published and tundra records each panel. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1446 identities would post 4648 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
